voice.reference_metadata_check: HTTP 200, 2026-09-07; no paid synthesis during setup
voice.fallback_policy: fail closed; never silently switch provider or voice
voice.speed_note: Owner requested shorter pauses and slightly faster Fish delivery on 2026-09-07. Default future edit 1.06x pitch-preserving; generate native speed and avoid applying acceleration twice.
voice.production_synthesis_check: Successful Fish synthesis of 92 words on 2026-09-07; native alignment and independent ASR match all words.

pause_edit.phoneme_protection: Cut only inside measured silence intersecting native inter-word gaps; preserve word edges and map timestamps
pause_edit.review_required: ASR word completeness + listening/owner review; never delete arbitrary low-volume speech

voice.script_delivery: One flowing paragraph, ONE Fish synthesis request per finalized script, not individual sentence clips. Preserve natural flow, owner-approved 1.06 edit; shorten only genuinely excessive detected silence.

format.extra_images_policy: Supersedes fixed 10+5 request after owner reviewed the silence video. Agent and Agnes generators remain available; no mandatory provider count. Existing 15-image cap is a safety ceiling, NOT a target; record per-production planned/accepted/used counts.
format.image_planning: Derive source-image count from researched script beats and timed storyboard, not a fixed generation quota. Reuse the exact scene asset for continuity; use UI/motion to reveal new information. No near-duplicate regenerated scenes.
format.motion_graphics: Hyperframes 0.8.31 local rendering, illustrated scenes plus concise useful UI synchronized to narration. Anchoring remake praised by owner 2026-09-08. No universal template quota; see HYPERFRAMES.md.
format.intro_video_policy: REQUIRED: actual animated opening plus a distinct authored opening zoom. Micro-camera movement on a still is not an acceptable substitute. If provider failure prevents a valid animated hook, report blocked; do not publish a downgraded opening. Bounded retries only; verify actual footage and zoom.
format.visual_focus_policy: One focal point per beat; simplify UI, remove completed elements and long on-screen academic footers; citations in description. Use brief selective blur/dimming for important ideas, not constantly. Keep captions and essential comparison context sharp.
format.visual_mix_policy: Owner praised anchoring direction but requests more genuinely distinct story illustrations and less continuous UI than that two-image treatment. Alternate story and concise UI as needed; no fixed image quota or near-duplicate regeneration.
format.character_expression_policy: Match simple facial expression and pose to each narrative beat: surprise, curiosity, frustration, worry, concentration, relief or joy. Avoid permanently bored faces; preserve identity and do not regenerate near-identical scenes just for a different mouth.
format.opening_label_policy: No Example prices overlay in future hooks. Narration/description contextualize hypothetical examples; do not remove necessary statistical context.
format.illustration_micro_motion: Owner2026-09-08 requests barely perceptible motion even during illustrated holds: typically1–2% scale change or a few pixels of drift over one shot. Monotonic, not pulsing or oscillating; captions stationary; preserve full bleed and identity.
format.character_identity_gate: Compare each final-cropped scene to canonical and approved references for head/body ratio, eye style, limbs and linework. Reject giant heads, redesigned characters and incongruous settings. Expressive brows/mouth do not permit identity drift.
format.visual_coverage_gate: Next approximately40s production: start with6–8 distinct meaningful illustrations, timed from narration; not a permanent quota. Flag holds over7s for explicit justification. Repeated source does not increase unique-image count. Micro-motion cannot substitute for visual coverage.
format.owner_rejected_production: 2026-09-08-familiar-is-not-verified: creative QA rejected; revised visual style awaits clarification.
format.visual_style_direction: Owner selected cleaner style2026-09-08: same Stiles, warm cream/teal/ochre, less background detail and texture, canonical proportions; first close-book render awaits owner review.

publishing.missed_slot_policy: mark/report overdue; do not backdate or dump overdue videos in a burst
publishing.generation_mode: agent production; publisher only uploads completed QA-passed assets
